name: 2023-2c-parcial1
title: Penalty shoot-out (Penales)
description: A single-shot penalty kick: a striker who shoots 'placed' or 'blasted', a Jabulani or a beach ball, and a keeper who picks a direction beforehand or waits and steps forward; each combination changes strengths, trajectories and who scores. The student must build the model that passes the 34 given tests, first with ifs and then replacing them with polymorphism.

design.notes: The outcome depends on the combination of three independent kinds (shot type x ball x keeper strategy, 8 cases), so the interesting design question is how to replace the designer's nested ifs on symbols with a multiple dispatch among strategy objects without duplicating the strength/direction rules.
